content_sections.heading: Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Department of Children Welfare and Special Services, District Child Protection Unit, Kallakurichi, dated 13 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DCPU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DCPU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 20 vacancies for Support Persons.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DCPU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Website http://kallakurichi.nic.in; the form is also printed on pages 4-5 of this PDF) and send it to District Child Protection Officer, 6th Floor, Room No.601, District Collectorate, Kallakurichi - 606 202, by in person, by post or courier, to reach by 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 25 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs.10,000 per case, released in 4 instalments of Rs.2,500 each.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post-graduate degree in Social Work, Sociology, Law, Psychology, Child Development or any other relevant field related to child welfare, health or education; OR a graduate with at least 3 years' experience in child education, development, health or protection issues. The English press release also lists persons/organizations working for child rights or child protection, and any person or organization sought by the child, the child's parents or guardian.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must work with police, CWC, DCPU, hospital and court in the child's best interest. Applicant must consent to police verification/background check as required for selection.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons with child rights violations and other criminal cases are not eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary basis on honorarium. Tenure of a Support Person is 3 years. Honorarium paid only for work on cases allotted; none for periods without allotted cases.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Kallakurichi district.
